operator_instruction.text: 這個是這禮拜的會議記錄。有下一波的實驗指示。你 ASR 後，照著做，至少 24HR GPU time

launch_authorization.scope: crop and re-level 17,100 rendered MIDI stimuli, score AES + MEva + VGGish + MIR, paired analysis, FAD checks on cached embeddings. No generation, no training.

question: On real piano pieces rendered from MAESTRO MIDI, do AES, MEva, VGGish FAD and the MIR readings drop under exaggerated note-level degradations, stay put under changes that should not matter, and where do the text-to-music systems sit between the clean render and a floor stimulus?

fixed_protocol.design: 150 excerpts x 2 SoundFonts x 57 cases (1 clean, 25 degrade, 11 control, 8 ambiguous, 12 floor)
fixed_protocol.views: full30 (30 s render) and crop10 (0.5-10.5 s, re-leveled)
fixed_protocol.level: -30 LUFS BS.1770 scalar gain, peak cap 0.999, mono 16 kHz, FLAC PCM_24
fixed_protocol.bootstrap: cluster = excerpt (150); 10,000 draws; seed 20261014; FAD bootstrap 100 excerpt-paired draws
fixed_protocol.reading: pre-registered directions per class in the design document; no human ratings; no CLAP (no captions)

resume.note: unit-level restart (view x SoundFont): a unit whose AES, MEva and FAD embeddings validate is skipped; a partial one is redone whole

completion_evidence.method: guest writes terminal with sha256 of the registered summary after --validate-only passes
